scenarios.name: Select the current appearance from an expanded panel title

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title and opens "Ribbon Appearance"
"Normal" is checked and the Modify additional commands remain visible
the user selects the checked "Normal" option
the menus and Modify additional command area close
the full ribbon remains visible with command labels
